what_the_2018_backup_said: *** "Roberto Paul (Llorens) Lerena", born EST 4 SEP 1872, Argentina. ***
what_the_current_tree_says: *** "Pablo Armando / Robert Paul Lerena", born 22 FEBRUARY 1882 at ROSARIO, Rosario Department. ***
why_it_matters: *** The single worst thing in the old file is gone. *** The current tree gives his own passport's date and his own passport's town. The Argentine researcher's 1872 candidate is no longer his birth record.

what_the_2018_backup_said: Parents: Roberto Llorens and Francisca Fernandez Lerena.
what_the_current_tree_says: *** Parents: STILL Roberto Llorens and "Francisca Fernandez Lerena". ***
why_it_matters: *** THIS IS NOT FIXED, AND DAVID SHOULD KNOW. *** The live tree now carries Rosario 1882 as his birth AND the Buenos Aires couple as his parents. *** Those two things cannot both be true. *** The birth was corrected and the parentage was left behind, and the mother's surname is still the spliced "Fernandez Lerena" that appears in no register.

what_the_current_tree_says: *** Careen Marie, born JUNE 1947, died 22 JUNE 1947 *** - daughter of Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena and Doreen May Chappell.
why_it_matters: *** The current tree agrees with the family and the old backup did not. *** Cheryl told her English cousin in 2020 that the infant in the Newlands grave was born and died in 1947. *** She was right to the month. *** She lived about three weeks.

what_the_2018_backup_said: Paul Lerena, born 3 NOVEMBER 1951 at DAPTO, WOLLONGONG, NEW SOUTH WALES.
what_the_current_tree_says: *** Paul Raymond Lerena, born 11 MARCH 1951 at JOHANNESBURG. *** No Australia anywhere.
why_it_matters: *** THE AUSTRALIAN BIRTH DOES NOT EXIST. *** This archive flagged the 2018 entry as "a date that cannot be true" because his sister was born in Johannesburg six months later. *** The flag was right and the cause was the backup being wrong. *** There was never an Australian birth in this generation and the work-list row chasing an NSW registration is struck.
